fields.description:
Prepare the committed helper and a verified real rehearsal artifact needed by the reclaim window. This story performs no remote ref deletion and never pushes. A6-1 alone refreshes the bundle if `origin/tickets` moved, deletes identified pins, and publishes the rewrite after all writers are quiesced. Session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 contains measured facts.

## Context

Remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` and host-local tag `refs/tags/pre-a3-remediation` retain pre-rewrite history. An in-repository backup ref would defeat reclamation, so rollback material must be a bundle outside every Git worktree and Git directory. Live ref OIDs are derived at execution time rather than from measured counts or hardcoded IDs.

## Plan

- Add `infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py`, a stock-Git CLI for a clean, unfiltered clone. It accepts the old tickets tip, an off-repo bundle path, a JSON manifest path, and repeatable pin-ref names. Import A6-0c `run_git`, `ref_name`, `is_partial_clone`, and `ReclaimError` from `reclaim_bridge_history.py` so safety behavior cannot drift.
- Enumerate `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` at run time, collapse annotated-tag `^{}` lines onto canonical refs, and record every head/tag with exact direct and peeled OIDs. For each commit tip, record one relationship to the old tip: same, old-tip-is-ancestor, ref-is-ancestor, diverged-with-merge-base, unrelated, or non-commit.
- Acquire `refs/reclaim-backup/lock` atomically with zero-object compare-and-swap before creating a run-unique `refs/reclaim-backup/<run-id>/` namespace. A concurrent or stale lock fails closed without deleting any helper ref and names a fresh-clone retry. Normal success and caught failures remove only the current namespace plus its owned lock in `finally`. After abnormal termination, discard that clone and retry in a fresh unfiltered clone; never sweep another run namespace.
- Resolve requested pins from live enumeration or the local clone and refuse missing/non-commit pins. Build the bundle from explicit temporary refs for the old tip and pins, then verify it.
- Refuse partial/promisor clones. Refuse bundle or manifest paths inside the repository, its Git directory, or another registered worktree. Create parent directories only outside those boundaries and never overwrite an artifact.
- Restore the bundle into a throwaway repository and compare restored old-tip and pin-tip OIDs exactly. Snapshot origin heads/tags before and after; no push, delete, or remote mutation is permitted.
- Run against a fresh real unfiltered clone and store the rehearsal bundle/manifest outside the repository. Record paths, SHA-256 checksums, sizes, old tip, pin tips, and bundle verification. A6-1 creates a fresh final bundle after quiescence whenever its old tip differs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] The helper enumerates every live origin head/tag at run time without a hardcoded count. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The manifest collapses each annotated-tag `^{}` line onto its canonical ref while retaining exact direct and peeled OIDs. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Every enumerated commit ref receives exactly one old-tip relationship. Tier: real Git fixtures for same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, and unrelated histories.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A non-commit ref is recorded without an ancestry command on that object. Tier: real Git remote with a blob ref.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A promisor or partial clone exits nonzero before creating a backup ref or artifact. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Partial-clone refusal names the fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A bundle destination inside any registered worktree or Git directory is refused. Tier: real worktree integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A manifest destination inside any registered worktree or Git directory is refused. Tier: real worktree integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An existing bundle artifact is not overwritten. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] An existing manifest artifact is not overwritten. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The bundle exposes a named ref resolving to the exact old-tip SHA. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The bundle exposes one named ref resolving to each requested pin-tip SHA. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `git bundle verify` succeeds for the completed bundle. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Bundle restore reproduces the old-tip SHA exactly. Tier: real Git restore integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Bundle restore reproduces every requested pin-tip SHA exactly. Tier: real Git restore integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A recording Git wrapper observes no push or remote-delete invocation. Tier: CLI integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Origin heads/tags output is byte-identical before and after success. Tier: real Git comparison.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Failed verification removes an incomplete bundle artifact. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Failed verification removes an incomplete manifest artifact. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A caught failure removes only the current run temp refs and owned lock. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A second overlapping run fails without deleting the first run refs. Tier: two-process integration with a deterministic barrier.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A stale helper lock fails closed with a fresh-clone retry message. Tier: real Git ref integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Retrying from a fresh clone after simulated abnormal termination succeeds with current requested OIDs. Tier: killed-process integration.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the rehearsal bundle absolute path.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the rehearsal manifest absolute path.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records SHA-256 checksums and byte sizes for both artifacts.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the observed old tip and included pin tips.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records successful `git bundle verify` output.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment confirms A6-0d changed no remote ref.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment requires A6-1 to recreate the final bundle when its quiet-window old tip differs.

## Verification commands

- `pytest tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py -v`
- `make lint`
- `make typecheck`
- `make test`

## Scope

`infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py` and `tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py`. No source-module, configuration, or remote-ref mutation. Scope: M. Depends on closed A6-0c; A6-1 consumes the helper and owns final refresh/deletion/publication.
